cue.text: This entire video is one XML file: a scene-render 1.1 document.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Everything you see and hear is declared, versioned and rendered deterministically.
Start with vector shapes: rectangles, ellipses, polygons, stars and SVG paths.
Fill them with linear, radial, conic or mesh gradients, draw them on with trim paths, and multiply them with repeaters.
Every attribute animates. Keyframes offer forty easing curves, from cubic-bezier to spring and bounce.
When keys are not enough, expressions, motion paths and links drive values from time, noise, audio or other nodes.
Text is first-class: variable fonts, styled spans and automatic fitting.
Text animators reveal it letter by letter, word by word, or along any path.
Bring in video, image sequences and Lottie files. Remap time, crop, fit and stabilise them.
Masks, track mattes, keying and thirty-five blend modes combine layers the way a compositor would.
Ninety effect types cover blur, glow, distortion, keying and stylisation.
Colour stays scene-referred: grade with CDL, curves or LUTs, and tone-map through ACES or OpenColorIO.
Step into three dimensions with primitives, glTF meshes and physically based materials.
Light the scene, then film it with a physical camera: focal length, aperture, depth of field and shake.
Rigid bodies fall, collide and bounce. Springs, pins and ropes connect them; cloth waves in the wind.
Particles emit smoke, sparks or confetti, pushed by vortex and wind fields. Every render is identical.
Turn numbers into animated charts, counters, formulas and scannable QR codes.
Characters bend with bones, inverse kinematics and puppet pins.
Parameters turn a scene into a template. Bind them to text, colours, assets and visibility.
Variants, data rows and reusable symbols generate hundreds of versions from one source.
The audio mix has tracks, buses, EQ, compression and loudness normalisation.
Music ducks under the voice automatically, and captions are timed word by word.
One scene renders to every placement: widescreen, vertical and square, each inside its safe area.
Choose H.264, ProRes, AV1 or EXR, in SDR or HDR, and deliver straight to storage.
